text:
marta: FYI noticed telemetry mismatch between py/ts SDKs this morning — route-priority header is getting dropped in sampled traces when sampling=low
ben: ugh, that explains the console weirdness we were seeing (routes showing <empty>)
shi: which header exactly? route-priority or X-Route-Meta?
marta: X-Route-Meta.priority — py sends it, ts shim currently serializes into route-hint but the sampler in gateway only looks for the original header
sam: so console attribution uses gateway-sampled spans -> if gateway sampler doesn't see X-Route-Meta.priority we misattribute to default route 
ben: can we add a graceful fallback in gateway sampler to check both headers? low-risk hotfix
shi: possible but that just masks the SDK divergence. we should align SDKs and do a phased rollout 
marta: agreed. propose: 1) gateway fallback for immediate relief 2) patch ts SDK to emit X-Route-Meta.priority again behind feature flag 3) backfill console mapping for last 24h where possible
sam: +1. what feature flag name? devex-compat-route-meta?
ben: maybe sdks.route_meta_legacy=true, default false for new installs
shi: implementation note: TS serializer was changed to compact route header to save bytes — it conflated fields. revert only priority field to original name behind flag
marta: test plan: unit for header name + e2e with gateway sampler at 0%, 10%, 50% canary in prod for 2h windows
console-bot: deploy canary created: gateway-sampler-fallback v1.0 -> canary 10% (id: ds-172999) :rocket:
ben: also watch console token-level dashboard — sampling heatmap and route attr graph, set alert if mismatch >5% vs baseline
shi: one more snag: go-sdk init order bug can ignore env var SDKS_ROUTE_META_LEGACY=true on cold starts, spotted in customer private deployment smoke tests
marta: oh no. does that affect only on-prem?
shi: mostly on-prem/container images that rely on env injection during startup sequencing. fix is trivial (move env read earlier) but will need patch release for go SDK too
sam: timeline? customers on Dedicated might hit this during migration window
marta: I can coordinate a patch release for ts/py/go: target TS 2.3.1 (flagged), PY 1.9.1, GO 0.7.5. aim to ship within 48h with rollback plan
ben: add a console migration job to backfill any spans missing priority for last 48h, mark them as estimated so dashboards show both counts
shi: will open PRs for each SDK, link to canary steps and test matrix in PR description
marta: I'll update the rollout doc and add a short note in Console release tile (ops) so SRE knows to monitor the canary id ds-172999
sam: also ping account success for customers on Dedicated/private to expect a short change window
devex-bot: reminder: add changelog entries and bump SDK ABI tags before release
ben: ok. I'll add alert runbook, mark on-call for evening window. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
shi: PRs: ts-> https://git.redwood/sdks/ts/pull/432, py-> https://git.redwood/sdks/py/pull/211, go-> https://git.redwood/sdks/go/pull/78
marta: linking these in the canary ticket and sending brief to #customer-success after patch is rolling. closing thread when canary shows stable for 4h.
